ayahs.2: Allah Taala woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahi, jo zinda aur sab ka nigehbaan hai.
ayahs.3: Jis ne aap par haq ke saath is kitaab ko naazil farmaya hai, jo apne se pehle ki tasdeeq karne wali hai, usi ne is se pehle Taurat aur Injeel ko utaara tha.
ayahs.4: Is se pehle, logon ko hidayat karne wali bana kar, aur Qur'an bhi usi ne utaara, jo log Allah Taala ki aayaton se kufr karte hain un ke liye sakht azaab hai aur Allah Taala ghaalib hai, badla lene wala hai.
ayahs.5: Yaqeenan Allah Taala par zameen-o-aasmaan ki koi cheez posheeda nahi.
ayahs.6: Woh maa ke pait mein tumhari sooraten jis tarah chahta hai banata hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood-e-bar-haq nahi, woh ghaalib hai, hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.7: Wahi Allah Taala hai jis ne tujh par kitaab utaari jis mein waazeh mazboot aayaten hain jo asal kitaab hain aur baaz mutashaabeh aayaten hain. Pas jin ke dilon mein kaji hai woh to us ki mutashaabeh aayaton ke peechhe lag jaate hain, fitne ki talab aur un ki muraad ki justajoo ke liye, haalaanke un ke haqeeqi muraad ko siwaaye Allah Taala ke koi nahi jaanta aur pukhta-o-mazboot ilm wale yahi kehte hain ke hum to un par imaan laa chuke, yeh hamare Rabb ki taraf se hain aur naseehat to sirf aqalmand haasil karte hain.
ayahs.8: Aye hamare Rabb! Hamein hidayat dene ke baad hamare dil tedhe na karde aur hamein apne paas se rehmat ata farma, yaqeenan tu hi bahut badi ata dene wala hai.
ayahs.9: Aye hamare Rabb! Tu yaqeenan logon ko ek din jama karne wala hai jis ke aane mein koi shak nahi, yaqeenan Allah Taala waada khilaafi nahi karta.
ayahs.10: Kaafiron ko un ke maal aur un ki aulaad Allah Taala (ke azaab) se chhudaane mein kuch kaam na aayengi, yeh to jahannam ka indhan hi hain.
ayahs.11: Jaisa aal-e-Firaun ka haal hua, aur un ka jo un se pehle the, unhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya, phir Allah Taala ne bhi unhe un ke gunaahon par pakad liya, aur Allah Taala sakht azaab wala hai.
ayahs.12: Kaafiron se keh dijiye! Ke tum anqareeb maghloob kiye jaao ge aur jahannam ki taraf jama kiye jaao ge aur woh bura thikaana hai.
ayahs.13: Yaqeenan tumhare liye ibrat ki nishaani thi un do jamaaton mein jo gutth gayi thin, ek jamaat to Allah Taala ki raah mein lad rahi thi aur doosra grooh kaafiron ka tha, woh unhe apni aankhon se apne se dugna dekhte the aur Allah Taala jise chaahe apni madad se qawi karta hai. Yaqeenan is mein aankhon walon ke liye badi ibrat hai.
ayahs.14: Marghoob cheezon ki muhabbat logon ke liye muzayyan kar di gayi hai, jaise aurten aur bete aur sone aur chaandi ke jama kiye hue khazane aur nishaandaar ghode aur chaupaaye aur kheti, yeh dunya ki zindagi ka saamaan hai aur lautne ka achha thikaana to Allah Taala hi ke paas hai.
ayahs.15: Aap keh dijiye! Kya main tumhe is se bahut hi behtar cheez bataoon? Taqwa walon ke liye un ke Rabb ta'ala ke paas jannaten hain jin ke neeche nahren beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha rahenge aur paakeeza biwiyaan aur Allah Taala ki razaamandi hai, sab bande Allah Taala ki nigaah mein hain.
ayahs.16: Jo kehte hain ke aye hamare Rabb! Hum imaan laa chuke, is liye hamare gunaah maaf farma aur hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
ayahs.17: Jo sabr karne wale aur sach bolne wale aur farmabardaari karne wale aur Allah ki raah mein kharch karne wale aur pichhli raat ko bakhshish maangne wale hain.
ayahs.18: Allah Taala, farishte aur ahl-e-ilm is baat ki gawaahi dete hain ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur woh adl ko qaaim rakhne wala hai, us ghaalib aur hikmat wale ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laaiq nahi.
ayahs.19: Beshak Allah Taala ke nazdeek deen-e-islam hi hai, aur ahl-e-kitaab ne apne paas ilm aa jaane ke baad aapas ki sarkashi aur hasad ki bina par hi ikhtilaaf kiya hai aur Allah Taala ki aayaton ke saath jo bhi kufr kare Allah Taala us ka jald hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.20: Phir bhi agar yeh aap se jhagden to aap keh den ke main aur mere taabedaaron ne Allah Taala ke saamne apna sar tasleem kham kar diya hai aur ahl-e-kitaab se aur an-padh logon se keh dijiye! Ke kya tum bhi itaa'at karte ho? Pas agar yeh bhi taabedaar ban jaayen to yaqeenan hidayat wale hain aur agar yeh roogardaani karen, to aap par sirf pahuncha dena hai aur Allah bandon ko khoob dekh bhaal raha hai.
ayahs.21: Jo log Allah Taala ki aayaton se kufr karte hain aur na-haq nabiyon ko qatl kar daalte hain aur jo log adl-o-insaaf ki baat kahen unhe bhi qatl kar daalte hain, to aye nabi! Unhe dardnaak azaab ki khabar de dijiye.
ayahs.22: Un ke aamaal dunya-o-aakhirat mein ghaarat hain aur un ka koi madadgaar nahi.
ayahs.23: Kya aap ne unhe nahi dekha jinhe ek hissa kitaab ka diya gaya hai, woh apne aapas ke faislon ke liye Allah Taala ki kitaab ki taraf bulaaye jaate hain, phir bhi ek jamaat un ki munh pher kar laut jaati hai.
ayahs.24: Is ki wajah un ka yeh kehna ke hamein to gine chune chand din hi aag jalaayegi, un ki gadhi gadhaayi baaton ne unhe un ke deen ke baare mein dhoke mein daal rakha hai.
ayahs.25: Pas kya haal hoga jabke hum unhe us din jama karenge? Jis ke aane mein koi shak nahi aur har shakhs apna apna kiya poora poora diya jaayega aur un par zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.26: Aap keh dijiye aye Allah! Aye tamaam jahaan ke Maalik! Tu jise chaahe baadshaahi de aur jis se chaahe saltanat chheen le aur tu jise chaahe izzat de aur jise chaahe zillat de, tere hi haath mein sab bhalaaiyaan hain, beshak tu har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.27: Tu hi raat ko din mein daakhil karta hai aur din ko raat mein le jaata hai, tu hi be-jaan se jaandaar paida karta hai aur tu hi jaandaar se be-jaan paida karta hai, tu hi hai ke jise chaahta hai be-shumaar rozi deta hai.
ayahs.28: Mominon ko chaahiye ke imaan walon ko chhod kar kaafiron ko apna dost na banaayen aur jo aisa karega woh Allah Taala ki kisi himaayat mein nahi magar yeh ke un ke shar se kisi tarah bachaao maqsood ho, aur Allah Taala khud tumhe apni zaat se dara raha hai aur Allah Taala hi ki taraf laut jaana hai.
ayahs.29: Keh dijiye! Ke khwaah tum apne seenon ki baaten chhupaao khwaah zaahir karo Allah Taala (baharhaal) jaanta hai, aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch hai sab use maloom hai aur Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.30: Jis din har nafs (shakhs) apni ki hui nekiyon ko aur apni ki hui buraaiyon ko maujood paalega, aarzu karega ke kaash! Us ke aur buraaiyon ke darmiyaan bahut hi doori hoti. Allah Taala tumhe apni zaat se dara raha hai aur Allah Taala apne bandon par bada hi meharban hai.
ayahs.31: Keh dijiye! Agar tum Allah Taala se muhabbat rakhte ho to meri taabedaari karo, khud Allah Taala tum se muhabbat karega aur tumhare gunaah maaf farma dega aur Allah Taala bada bakhshne wala meharban hai.
ayahs.32: Keh dijiye! Ke Allah Taala aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo, agar yeh munh pher len to beshak Allah Taala kaafiron se muhabbat nahi karta.
ayahs.33: Beshak Allah Taala ne tamaam jahaan ke logon mein se Aadam (alaihis salaam) ko aur Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko, Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ke khaandaan aur Imran ke khaandaan ko muntakhab farma liya.
ayahs.34: Ke yeh sab aapas mein ek doosre ki nasal se hain aur Allah Taala sunta jaanta hai.
ayahs.35: Jab Imran ki biwi ne kaha ke aye mere Rabb! Mere pait mein jo kuch hai, use main ne tere naam aazaad karne ki nazr maani, to meri taraf se qubool farma! Yaqeenan tu khoob sunne wala aur poori tarah jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.36: Jab bachchi ko jana to kehne lagin ke parwardigaar! Mujhe to ladki hui, Allah Taala ko khoob maloom hai ke kya aulaad hui hai aur ladka ladki jaisa nahi, main ne us ka naam Maryam rakha, main use aur us ki aulaad ko shaitaan mardood se teri panaah mein deti hoon.
ayahs.37: Pas use us ke parwardigaar ne achhi tarah qubool farmaya aur use behtareen parwarish di. Us ki khair khabar lene wala Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ko banaya, jab kabhi Zakariya (alaihis salaam) un ke hujre mein jaate un ke paas rozi rakhi hui paate, woh poochhte aye Maryam! Yeh rozi tumhare paas kahaan se aayi? Woh jawaab detin ke yeh Allah Taala ke paas se hai, beshak Allah Taala jise chaahe be-shumaar rozi de.
ayahs.38: Isi jagah Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rabb se dua ki, kaha ke aye mere parwardigaar! Mujhe apne paas se paakeeza aulaad ata farma, beshak tu dua ka sunne wala hai.
ayahs.39: Pas farishton ne unhe aawaaz di, jabke woh hujre mein khade namaz padh rahe the, ke Allah Taala tujhe Yahya ki yaqini khushkhabri deta hai jo Allah Taala ke kalime ki tasdeeq karne wala, sardaar, zaabit-e-nafs aur nabi hai nek logon mein se.
ayahs.40: Kehne lage aye mere Rabb! Mere haan bachcha kaise hoga? Main bilkul boodha ho gaya hoon aur meri biwi baanjh hai, farmaya, isi tarah Allah Taala jo chaahe karta hai.
ayahs.41: Kehne lage parwardigaar! Mere liye is ki koi nishaani muqarrar kar de, farmaya, nishaani yeh hai ke teen din tak tu logon se baat na kar sakega, sirf ishaare se samjhaayega, tu apne Rabb ka zikr kasrat se kar aur subah-o-shaam usi ki tasbeeh bayaan karta reh!
ayahs.42: Aur jab farishton ne kaha, aye Maryam! Allah Taala ne tujhe barguzeeda kar liya aur tujhe paak kar diya aur saare jahaan ki aurton mein se tera intikhaab kar liya.
ayahs.43: Aye Maryam! Tu apne Rabb ki itaa'at kar aur sajda kar aur ruku karne walon ke saath ruku kar.
ayahs.44: Yeh ghaib ki khabron mein se hai jise hum teri taraf wahi se pahunchaate hain, tu un ke paas na tha jabke woh apne qalam daal rahe the ke Maryam ko un mein se kaun paalega? Aur na tu un ke jhagadne ke waqt un ke paas tha.
ayahs.45: Jab farishton ne kaha aye Maryam Allah Taala tujhe apne ek kalime ki khushkhabri deta hai jis ka naam Maseeh Eesa bin Maryam hai jo dunya aur aakhirat mein zi-izzat hai aur woh mere muqarrabeen mein se hai.
ayahs.46: Woh logon se apne gehwaare mein baaten karega aur adhed umr mein bhi aur woh nek logon mein se hoga.
ayahs.47: Kehne lagin ilahi mujhe ladka kaise hoga? Haalaanke mujhe to kisi insaan ne haath bhi nahi lagaaya, farishte ne kaha, isi tarah Allah Taala jo chaahe paida karta hai, jab kabhi woh kisi kaam ko karna chaahta hai to sirf yeh keh deta hai ke ho ja! To woh ho jaata hai.
ayahs.48: Allah Taala use likhna aur hikmat aur Taurat aur Injeel sikhaayega.
ayahs.49: Aur woh Bani Israeel ki taraf Rasool hoga, ke main tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki nishaani laaya hoon, main tumhare liye parinde ki shakl ki tarah mitti ka parinda banata hoon, phir us mein phoonk maarta hoon to woh Allah Taala ke hukm se parinda ban jaata hai aur Allah Taala ke hukm se main maadar-zaad andhe ko aur kodhi ko achha kar deta hoon aur murdon ko zinda karta hoon aur jo kuch tum khaao aur jo apne gharon mein zakheera karo main tumhe bata deta hoon, is mein tumhare liye badi nishaani hai, agar tum imaan laane wale ho.
ayahs.50: Aur main Taurat ki tasdeeq karne wala hoon jo mere saamne hai aur main is liye aaya hoon ke tum par baaz woh cheezen halaal karoon jo tum par haraam kar di gayi hain aur main tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki nishaani laaya hoon, is liye tum Allah Taala se daro aur meri farmabardaari karo!
ayahs.51: Yaqeen maano! Mera aur tumhara Rabb Allah hi hai, tum sab usi ki ibaadat karo, yahi seedhi raah hai.
ayahs.52: Magar jab Hazrat Eesa (alaihis salaam) ne un ka kufr mehsoos kar liya to kehne lage Allah Taala ki raah mein meri madad karne wala kaun kaun hai? Hawariyon ne jawaab diya ke hum Allah Taala ki raah ke madadgaar hain, hum Allah Taala par imaan laaye aur aap gawaah rahiye ke hum taabedaar hain.
ayahs.53: Aye hamare paalne wale mabood! Hum teri utaari hui wahi par imaan laaye aur hum ne tere Rasool ki ittebaa ki, pas tu hamein gawaahon mein likh le.
ayahs.54: Aur kaafiron ne makr kiya aur Allah Taala ne bhi (makr) khufiya tadbeer ki aur Allah Taala sab khufiya tadbeer karne walon se behtar hai.
ayahs.55: Jab Allah Taala ne farmaya ke aye Eesa! Main tujhe poora lene wala hoon aur tujhe apni jaanib uthaane wala hoon aur tujhe kaafiron se paak karne wala hoon aur tere taabedaaron ko kaafiron ke oopar ghaalib karne wala hoon qayamat ke din tak, phir tum sab ka lautna meri hi taraf hai, main hi tumhare aapas ke tamaam tar ikhtilaafaat ka faisla karoonga.
ayahs.56: Phir kaafiron ko to main dunya aur aakhirat mein sakht tar azaab doonga aur un ka koi madadgaar na hoga.
ayahs.57: Lekin imaan walon aur nek aamaal walon ko Allah Taala un ka sawaab poora poora dega aur Allah Taala zaalimon se muhabbat nahi karta.
ayahs.58: Yeh jise hum tere saamne padh rahe hain aayaten hain aur hikmat wali naseehat hain.
ayahs.59: Allah Taala ke nazdeek Eesa (alaihis salaam) ki misaal ho bahoo Aadam (alaihis salaam) ki misaal hai jise mitti se bana kar ke keh diya ke ho ja! Pas woh ho gaya!
ayahs.60: Tere Rabb ki taraf se haq yahi hai, khabardaar shak karne walon mein na hona.
ayahs.61: Is liye jo shakhs aap ke paas is ilm ke aa jaane ke baad bhi aap se is mein jhagde to aap keh den ke aao hum tum apne apne farzandon ko aur hum tum apni apni aurton ko aur hum tum khaas apni apni jaanon ko bula len, phir hum aajizi ke saath iltija karen aur jhooton par Allah ki laanat karen.
ayahs.62: Yaqeenan sirf yahi sachcha bayaan hai aur koi mabood-e-bar-haq nahi bajuz Allah Taala ke aur beshak ghaalib aur hikmat wala Allah Taala hi hai.
ayahs.63: Phir bhi agar qubool na karen to Allah Taala bhi saheeh taur par fasaadiyon ko jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.64: Aap keh dijiye ke aye ahl-e-kitaab! Aisi insaaf wali baat ki taraf aao jo hum mein tum mein baraabar hai ke hum Allah Taala ke siwa kisi ki ibaadat na karen, na us ke saath kisi ko shareek banaayen, na Allah Taala ko chhod kar aapas mein ek doosre ko hi Rabb banaayen. Pas agar woh munh pher len to tum keh do ke gawaah raho hum to musalmaan hain.
ayahs.65: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Tum Ibraheem ki baabat kyun jhagadte ho haalaanke Taurat-o-Injeel to un ke baad naazil ki gayin, kya tum phir bhi nahi samajhte?
ayahs.66: Suno! Tum log is mein jhagad chuke jis ka tumhe ilm tha, phir ab is baat mein kyun jhagadte ho jis ka tumhe ilm hi nahi? Aur Allah Taala jaanta hai aur tum nahi jaante.
ayahs.67: Ibraheem to na yahoodi the na nasraani the balke woh to yak-tarfa (khaalis) musalmaan the, woh mushrik bhi nahi the.
ayahs.68: Sab logon se ziyaada Ibraheem se nazdeek tar woh log hain jinhon ne un ka kaha maana aur yeh nabi aur jo log imaan laaye, mominon ka wali aur sahaara Allah hi hai.
ayahs.69: Ahl-e-kitaab ki ek jamaat chaahti hai ke tumhe gumraah kar den. Dar-asal woh khud apne aap ko gumraah kar rahe hain aur samajhte nahi.
ayahs.70: Aye ahl-e-kitaab tum (baa-wujood qaail hone ke phir bhi) daanista Allah ki aayaat ka kyun kufr kar rahe ho?
ayahs.71: Aye ahl-e-kitaab! Baa-wujood jaanne ke haq-o-baatil ko kyun khalt-malt kar rahe ho aur kyun haq ko chhupa rahe ho?
ayahs.72: Aur ahl-e-kitaab ki ek jamaat ne kaha ke jo kuch imaan walon par utaara gaya hai us par din chadhe to imaan lao aur shaam ke waqt kaafir ban jaao, taake yeh log bhi palat jaayen.
ayahs.73: Aur siwaaye tumhare deen par chalne walon ke aur kisi ka yaqeen na karo. Aap keh dijiye ke beshak hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai (aur yeh bhi kehte hain ke is baat ka bhi yaqeen na karo) ke koi us jaisa diya jaaye jaisa tum diye gaye ho, ya yeh ke yeh tum se tumhare Rabb ke paas jhagda karenge, aap keh dijiye ke fazl to Allah Taala hi ke haath mein hai, woh jise chaahe use de, Allah Taala wusat wala aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.74: Woh apni rehmat ke saath jise chaahe makhsoos kar le aur Allah Taala bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.75: Baaz ahl-e-kitaab to aise hain ke agar unhe tu khazane ka ameen bana de to bhi woh tujhe waapas kar den aur un mein se baaz aise bhi hain ke agar tu unhe ek deenaar bhi amaanat de to tujhe ada na karen. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke tu us ke sar par hi khada rahe, yeh is liye ke unhon ne keh rakha hai ke hum par in jaahilon (ghair yahoodi) ke haq ka koi gunaah nahi, yeh log baa-wujood jaanne ke Allah Taala par jhoot kehte hain.
ayahs.76: Kyun nahi (muakhaza hoga), albatta jo shakhs apna qaraar poora kare aur parhezgaari kare, to Allah Taala bhi aise parhezgaaron se muhabbat karta hai.
ayahs.77: Beshak jo log Allah Taala ke ahd aur apni qasmon ko thodi qeemat par bech daalte hain, un ke liye aakhirat mein koi hissa nahi, Allah Taala na to un se baat cheet karega na un ki taraf qayamat ke din dekhega, na unhe paak karega aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.78: Yaqeenan un mein aisa grooh bhi hai jo kitaab padhte hue apni zabaan marodta hai taake tum use kitaab hi ki ibaarat khayaal karo haalaanke dar-asal woh kitaab mein se nahi, aur yeh kehte bhi hain ke woh Allah Taala ki taraf se hai haalaanke dar-asal woh Allah Taala ki taraf se nahi, woh to daanista Allah Taala par jhoot bolte hain.
ayahs.79: Kisi aise insaan ko jise Allah Taala kitaab-o-hikmat aur nabuwat de, yeh laaiq nahi ke phir bhi woh logon se kahe ke tum Allah Taala ko chhod kar mere bande ban jaao, balke woh to kahega ke tum sab Rabb ke ho jaao, tumhare kitaab sikhaane ke baais aur tumhare kitaab padhne ke sabab.
ayahs.80: Aur yeh nahi (ho sakta) ke woh tumhe farishton aur nabiyon ko Rabb bana lene ka hukm kare, kya woh tumhare musalmaan hone ke baad bhi tumhe kufr ka hukm dega.
ayahs.81: Jab Allah Taala ne nabiyon se ahd liya ke jo kuch main tumhe kitaab-o-hikmat doon phir tumhare paas woh Rasool aaye jo tumhare paas ki cheez ko sach bataaye to tumhare liye us par imaan laana aur us ki madad karna zaroori hai. Farmaya ke tum is ke iqraari ho aur is par mera zimma le rahe ho? Sab ne kaha ke hamein iqraar hai, farmaya to ab gawaah raho aur khud main bhi tumhare saath gawaahon mein hoon.
ayahs.82: Pas is ke baad bhi jo palat jaayen woh yaqeenan poore naafarmaan hain.
ayahs.83: Kya woh Allah Taala ke deen ke siwa aur deen ki talaash mein hain? Haalaanke tamaam aasmaanon wale aur sab zameen wale Allah Taala hi ke farmabardaar hain khushi se hon ya na-khushi se, sab usi ki taraf lautaaye jaayenge.
ayahs.84: Aap keh dijiye ke hum Allah Taala par aur jo kuch hum par utaara gaya hai aur jo kuch Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) aur Ismaeel (alaihis salaam) aur Ishaaq (alaihis salaam) aur Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) aur un ki aulaad par utaara gaya aur jo kuch Moosa aur Eesa (alaihimas-salaam) aur doosre ambiya (alaihim salaam) Allah Taala ki taraf se diye gaye, un sab par imaan laaye, hum un mein se kisi ke darmiyaan farq nahi karte aur hum Allah Taala ke farmabardaar hain.
ayahs.85: Jo shakhs Islam ke siwa aur deen talaash kare, us ka deen qubool na kiya jaayega aur woh aakhirat mein nuqsaan paane walon mein hoga.
ayahs.86: Allah Taala un logon ko kaise hidayat dega jo apne imaan laane aur Rasool ki haqqaaniyat ki gawaahi dene aur apne paas roshan daleelen aa jaane ke baad kaafir ho jaayen, Allah Taala aise be-insaaf logon ko raah-e-raast par nahi laata.
ayahs.87: Un ki to yahi saza hai ke un par Allah Taala ki aur farishton ki aur tamaam logon ki laanat ho.
ayahs.88: Jis mein yeh hamesha pade rahenge, na to un se azaab halka kiya jaayega na unhe mohlat di jaayegi.
ayahs.89: Magar jo log is ke baad tauba aur islaah kar len to beshak Allah Taala bakhshne wala meharban hai.
ayahs.90: Beshak jo log apne imaan laane ke baad kufr karen phir kufr mein badh jaayen, un ki tauba hargiz hargiz qubool na ki jaayegi, yahi gumraah log hain.
ayahs.91: Haan jo log kufr karen aur marte dam tak kaafir rahen un mein se koi agar zameen bhar sona de, go fidye mein hi ho to bhi hargiz qubool na kiya jaayega. Yahi log hain jin ke liye takleef dene wala azaab hai aur jin ka koi madadgaar nahi.
ayahs.92: Jab tak tum apni pasandeeda cheez se Allah Taala ki raah mein kharch na karoge hargiz bhalaai na paaoge, aur tum jo kharch karo use Allah Taala bakhoobi jaanta hai.
ayahs.93: Taurat ke nuzool se pehle (Hazrat) Yaqoob (alaihis salaam) ne jis cheez ko apne oopar haraam kar liya tha us ke siwa tamaam khaane Bani Israeel par halaal the, aap keh dijiye ke agar tum sachche ho to Taurat le aao aur padh kar sunaao.
ayahs.94: Is ke baad bhi jo log Allah Taala par jhoot bohtan baandhen wahi zaalim hain.
ayahs.95: Keh dijiye ke Allah Taala sachcha hai, tum sab Ibraheem haneef ke millat ki pairwi karo, jo mushrik na the.
ayahs.96: Allah Taala ka pehla ghar jo logon ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya wahi hai jo Makkah (shareef) mein hai jo tamaam dunya ke liye barkat-o-hidayat wala hai.
ayahs.97: Jis mein khuli khuli nishaaniyaan hain, Maqaam-e-Ibraheem hai, is mein jo aa jaaye aman wala ho jaata hai Allah Taala ne un logon par jo us ki taraf raah paa sakte hon is ghar ka hajj farz kar diya hai. Aur jo koi kufr kare to Allah Taala (is se balke) tamaam dunya se be-parwaah hai.
ayahs.98: Aap keh dijiye ke aye ahl-e-kitaab tum Allah Taala ki aayaton ke saath kufr kyun karte ho? Jo kuch tum karte ho, Allah Taala us par gawaah hai.
ayahs.99: In ahl-e-kitaab se kaho ke tum Allah Taala ki raah se logon ko kyun rokte ho? Aur is mein aib tatolte ho, haalaanke tum khud shaahid ho, Allah Taala tumhare aamaal se be-khabar nahi.
ayahs.100: Aye imaan walo! Agar tum ahl-e-kitaab ki kisi jamaat ki baaten maanoge to woh tumhe tumhare imaan laane ke baad murtad kaafir bana denge.
ayahs.101: (Go yeh zaahir hai ke) tum kaise kufr kar sakte ho? Baa-wujood yeh ke tum par Allah Taala ki aayaten padhi jaati hain aur tum mein Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) maujood hain. Jo shakhs Allah Taala (ke deen) ko mazboot thaam le to bila-shubha use raah-e-raast dikha di gayi.
ayahs.102: Aye imaan walo! Allah Taala se itna daro jitna us se darna chaahiye aur dekho marte dam tak musalmaan hi rehna.
ayahs.103: Allah Taala ki rassi ko sab mil kar mazboot thaam lo aur phoot na daalo, aur Allah Taala ki us waqt ki ne'mat ko yaad karo jab tum ek doosre ke dushman the, to us ne tumhare dilon mein ulfat daal di, pas tum us ki meharbaani se bhai bhai hogaye, aur tum aag ke gadhe ke kinaare pahunch chuke the to us ne tumhe bacha liya. Allah Taala isi tarah tumhare liye apni nishaaniyaan bayaan karta hai taake tum hidayat paao.
ayahs.104: Tum mein se ek jamaat aisi honi chaahiye jo bhalaai ki taraf bulaaye aur nek kaamon ka hukm kare aur bure kaamon se roke, aur yahi log falah-o-najat paane wale hain.
ayahs.105: Tum un logon ki tarah na ho jaana jinhon ne apne paas roshan daleelen aa jaane ke baad bhi tafarruqa daala, aur ikhtilaaf kiya, unhi logon ke liye bada azaab hai.
ayahs.106: Jis din baaz chehre safed honge aur baaz siyaah, siyaah chehre walon (se kaha jaayega) ke kya tum ne imaan laane ke baad kufr kiya? Ab apne kufr ka azaab chakho.
ayahs.107: Aur safed chehre wale Allah Taala ki rehmat mein daakhil honge aur is mein hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.108: Aye nabi! Hum in haqqaani aayaton ki tilaawat aap par kar rahe hain aur Allah Taala ka iraada logon par zulm karne ka nahi.
ayahs.109: Allah Taala hi ke liye hai jo kuch aasmaanon aur zameen mein hai aur Allah Taala hi ki taraf tamaam kaam lautaaye jaate hain.
ayahs.110: Tum behtareen ummat ho jo logon ke liye paida ki gayi hai ke tum nek baaton ka hukm karte ho aur buri baaton se rokte ho, aur Allah Taala par imaan rakhte ho, agar ahl-e-kitaab bhi imaan laate to un ke liye behtar tha, un mein imaan wale bhi hain lekin aksar to faasiq hain.
ayahs.111: Yeh tumhe sataane ke siwa aur ziyaada kuch zarar nahi pahuncha sakte, agar ladaai ka mauqa aa jaaye to peeth mod lenge, phir madad na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.112: Un par har jagah zillat ki maar padi, illa yeh ke Allah Taala ki ya logon ki panaah mein hon, yeh ghazab-e-ilahi ke mustahiq hogaye aur un par faqeeri daal di gayi, yeh is liye ke yeh log Allah Taala ki aayaton se kufr karte the aur be-wajah ambiya ko qatl karte the, yeh badla hai un ki naafarmaaniyon aur ziyaadatiyon ka.
ayahs.113: Yeh saare ke saare yaksa nahi balke in ahl-e-kitaab mein ek jamaat (haq par) qaaim rehne wali bhi hai jo raaton ke waqt bhi kalaam-e-Allah ki tilaawat karte hain aur sajde bhi karte hain.
ayahs.114: Yeh Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan bhi rakhte hain, bhalaaiyon ka hukm karte hain aur buraaiyon se rokte hain aur bhalaai ke kaamon mein jaldi karte hain. Yeh nek bakht logon mein se hain.
ayahs.115: Yeh jo kuch bhi bhalaaiyaan karen un ki na-qadri na ki jaayegi aur Allah Taala parhezgaaron ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.116: Kaafiron ko un ke maal aur un ki aulaad Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayengi, yeh to jahannami hain jo hamesha usi mein pade rahenge.
ayahs.117: Yeh kuffaar jo kharch akhraajaat karen us ki misaal yeh hai ke ek tund hawa chali jis se paala tha jo zaalimon ki kheti par pada aur use tahas-nahas kar diya. Allah Taala ne un par zulm nahi kiya balke woh khud apni jaanon par zulm karte the.
ayahs.118: Aye imaan walo! Tum apna dili dost imaan walon ke siwa aur kisi ko na banaao. (Tum to) nahi dekhte doosre log tumhari tabaahi mein koi kasar utha nahi rakhte, woh to chaahte hain ke tum dukh mein pado, un ki adaawat to khud un ki zabaan se bhi zaahir ho chuki hai aur jo un ke seenon mein posheeda hai woh bahut ziyaada hai, hum ne tumhare liye aayaten bayaan kar din agar aqalmand ho (to ghaur karo).
ayahs.119: Haan tum to unhe chaahte ho aur woh tum se muhabbat nahi rakhte, tum poori kitaab ko maante ho, (woh nahi maante phir muhabbat kaisi?) Yeh tumhare saamne to apne imaan ka iqraar karte hain lekin tanhaai mein maare ghusse ke ungliyaan chabaate hain, keh do ke apne ghusse hi mein mar jaao, Allah Taala dilon ke raaz ko bakhoobi jaanta hai.
ayahs.120: Tumhe agar bhalaai mile to yeh na-khush hote hain, haan! Agar buraai pahunche to khush hote hain, tum agar sabr karo aur parhezgaari karo to un ka makr tumhe kuch nuqsaan na dega. Allah Taala ne un ke aamaal ka ihaata kar rakha hai.
ayahs.121: Aye nabi! Us waqt ko bhi yaad karo jab subah hi subah aap apne ghar se nikal kar musalmaanon ko maidan-e-jang mein ladaai ke morchon par ba-qaida bitha rahe the, Allah Taala sunne jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.122: Jab tumhari do jamaaten past-himmati ka iraada kar chuki thin, Allah Taala un ka wali aur madadgaar hai. Aur usi ki paak zaat par mominon ko bharosa rakhna chaahiye.
ayahs.123: jang-e-badr mein Allah Taala ne ain us waqt tumhari madad farmaayi thi jabke tum nihaayat giri hui haalat mein the, is liye Allah hi se daro! (Na kisi aur se) taake tumhe shukr guzaari ki taufeeq ho.
ayahs.124: (Aur yeh shukr guzaari baais-e-nusrat-o-imdad ho) jab aap mominon ko tasalli de rahe the, kya aasmaan se teen hazaar farishte utaar kar Allah Taala ka tumhari madad karna tumhe kaafi na hoga.
ayahs.125: Kyun nahi, balke agar tum sabr-o-parhezgaari karo aur yeh log isi dam tumhare paas aa jaayen to tumhara Rabb tumhari imdad paanch hazaar farishton se karega jo nishaandaar honge.
ayahs.126: Aur yeh to mehaz tumhare dil ki khushi aur itminan-e-qalb ke liye hai, warna madad to Allah hi ki taraf se hai jo ghaalib aur hikmaton wala hai.
ayahs.127: (Is imdad-e-ilahi ka maqsad yeh tha ke Allah) kaafiron ki ek jamaat ko kaat de ya unhe zaleel kar daale aur (saare ke saare) naamuraad ho kar waapas chale jaayen.
ayahs.128: Aye paighambar! Aap ke ikhtiyaar mein kuch nahi, Allah Taala chaahe to un ki tauba qubool kare ya azaab de, kyunke woh zaalim hain.
ayahs.129: Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo kuch hai sab Allah hi ka hai, woh jise chaahe bakhshe, jise chaahe azaab kare, Allah Taala bakhshish karne wala meharban hai.
ayahs.130: Aye imaan walo! Badha chadha kar sood na khaao, aur Allah Taala se daro taake tumhe najat mile.
ayahs.131: Aur us aag se daro jo kaafiron ke liye taiyaar ki gayi hai.
ayahs.132: Aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki farmabardaari karo taake tum par reham kiya jaaye.
ayahs.133: Aur apne Rabb ki bakhshish ki taraf aur us jannat ki taraf daudo jis ka arz aasmaanon aur zameen ke baraabar hai, jo parhezgaaron ke liye taiyaar ki gayi hai.
ayahs.134: Jo log aasaani mein sakhti ke mauqa par bhi Allah ke raaste mein kharch karte hain, ghussa peene wale aur logon se darguzar karne wale hain, Allah Taala un nek kaaron se muhabbat karta hai.
ayahs.135: Jab un se koi nashaista kaam ho jaaye ya koi gunaah kar baithen to foran Allah ka zikr aur apne gunaahon ke liye istighfaar karte hain, fil-waqe Allah Taala ke siwa aur kaun gunaahon ko bakhsh sakta hai? Aur woh log baa-wujood ilm ke kisi bure kaam par ad nahi jaate.
ayahs.136: Unhi ka badla un ke Rabb ki taraf se maghfirat hai aur jannaten hain jin ke neeche nahren behti hain, jin mein woh hamesha rahenge, un nek kaamon ke karne walon ka sawaab kya hi achha hai.
ayahs.137: Tum se pehle bhi aise waaqiaat guzar chuke hain, so zameen mein chal phir kar dekh lo ke (aasmaani taaleem ke) jhutlaane walon ka kya anjaam hua?
ayahs.138: Aam logon ke liye to yeh (Qur'an) bayaan hai aur parhezgaaron ke liye hidayat-o-naseehat hai.
ayahs.139: Tum na susti karo aur ghamgeen ho, tum hi ghaalib rahoge, agar tum imaandaar ho.
ayahs.140: Agar tum zakhmi hue ho to tumhare mukhaalif log bhi to aise hi zakhmi ho chuke hain, hum in dinon ko logon ke darmiyaan adalte badalte rehte hain. (shikast-e-uhud) is liye thi ke Allah Taala imaan walon ko zaahir kar de aur tum mein se baaz ko shahadat ka darja ata farmaaye, Allah Taala zaalimon se muhabbat nahi karta.
ayahs.141: (Yeh wajah bhi thi) ke Allah Taala imaan walon ko bilkul alag kar de aur kaafiron ko mita de.
ayahs.142: Kya tum yeh samajh baithe ho ke tum jannat mein chale jaaoge, haalaanke ab tak Allah Taala ne yeh zaahir nahi kiya ke tum se jihaad karne wale kaun hain aur sabr karne wale kaun hain?
ayahs.143: Jang se pehle to tum shahadat ki aarzu mein the, ab use apni aankhon se apne saamne dekh liya.
ayahs.144: (Hazrat) Muhammad (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) sirf Rasool hi hain, un se pehle bahut se Rasool ho chuke hain, kya agar un ka intiqaal ho jaaye ya yeh shaheed ho jaayen, to tum Islam se apni ediyon ke bal phir jaaoge? Aur jo koi phir jaaye apni ediyon par to hargiz Allah Taala ka kuch na bigaadega, anqareeb Allah Taala shukr guzaaron ko nek badla dega.
ayahs.145: Baghair Allah Taala ke hukm ke koi jaandaar nahi mar sakta, muqarrar-shuda waqt likha hua hai, dunya ki chaahat walon ko hum kuch dunya de dete hain aur aakhirat ka sawaab chaahne walon ko hum woh bhi denge. Aur ehsaan maanne walon ko hum bahut jald nek badla denge.
ayahs.146: Bahut se nabiyon ke humrikab ho kar, bahut se Allah wale jihaad kar chuke hain, unhe bhi Allah ki raah mein takleefen pahunchin lekin na to unhon ne himmat haari na sust rahe aur na dabe, aur Allah sabr karne walon ko (hi) chaahta hai.
ayahs.147: Woh yahi kehte rahe ke aye parwardigaar! Hamare gunaahon ko bakhsh de aur hum se hamare kaamon mein jo be-ja ziyaadati hui hai use bhi maaf farma aur hamein sabit-qadmi ata farma aur hamein kaafiron ki qaum par madad de.
ayahs.148: Allah Taala ne unhe dunya ka sawaab bhi diya aur aakhirat ke sawaab ki khoobi bhi ata farmaayi aur Allah Taala nek logon se muhabbat karta hai.
ayahs.149: Aye imaan walo! Agar tum kaafiron ki baaten maanoge to woh tumhe tumhari ediyon ke bal palta denge, (yani tumhe murtad bana denge) phir tum naamuraad ho jaaoge.
ayahs.150: Balke Allah hi tumhara maula hai aur wahi behtareen madadgaar hai.
ayahs.151: Hum anqareeb kaafiron ke dilon mein rob daal denge, is wajah se ke yeh Allah ke saath un cheezon ko shareek karte hain jis ki koi daleel Allah ne nahi utaari, un ka thikaana jahannam hai, aur un zaalimon ki buri jagah hai.
ayahs.152: Allah Taala ne tum se apna waada sachcha kar dikhaaya jabke tum us ke hukm se unhe kaat rahe the. Yahaan tak ke jab tum ne past-himmati ikhtiyaar ki aur kaam mein jhagadne lage aur naafarmaani ki, is ke baad ke us ne tumhari chaahat ki cheez tumhe dikha di, tum mein se baaz dunya chaahte the aur baaz ka iraada aakhirat ka tha to phir us ne tumhe un se pher diya taake tum ko aazmaaye aur yaqeenan us ne tumhari laghzish se darguzar farma diya aur imaan walon par Allah Taala bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.153: Jabke tum chadhe chale ja rahe the aur kisi taraf tawajjo tak nahi karte the aur Allah ke Rasool tumhe tumhare peechhe se aawaazen de rahe the, bas tumhe gham par gham pahuncha taake tum faut-shuda cheez par ghamgeen na ho aur na pahunchne wali (takleef) par udaas ho, Allah Taala tumhare tamaam aamaal se khabardaar hai.
ayahs.154: Phir us ne us gham ke baad tum par aman naazil farmaya aur tum mein se ek jamaat ko aman ki neend aane lagi. Haan kuch woh log bhi the ke unhe apni jaanon ki padi hui thi, woh Allah Taala ke saath na-haq jahaalat bhari badgumaaniyan kar rahe the aur kehte the kya hamein bhi kisi cheez ka ikhtiyaar hai? Aap keh dijiye ke kaam kul ka kul Allah ke ikhtiyaar mein hai, yeh log apne dilon ke bhed aap ko nahi bataate, kehte hain ke agar hamein kuch bhi ikhtiyaar hota to yahaan qatl na kiye jaate. Aap keh dijiye ke go tum apne gharon mein hote phir bhi jin ki qismat mein qatl hona tha woh to maqtal ki taraf chal khade hote, Allah Taala ko tumhare seenon ke andar ki cheez ka aazmaana aur jo kuch tumhare dilon mein hai, us ko paak karna tha, aur Allah Taala seenon ke bhed se aagaah hai.
ayahs.155: Tum mein se jin logon ne us din peeth dikhaayi jis din dono jamaaton ki mudbhed hui thi yeh log apne baaz kartooton ke baais shaitaan ke phislaane mein aa gaye lekin yaqeen jaano ke Allah Taala ne unhe maaf kar diya Allah Taala hai bakhshne wala aur tahammul wala.
ayahs.156: Aye imaan walo! Tum un logon ki tarah na ho jaana jinhon ne kufr kiya aur apne bhaiyon ke haq mein jabke woh safar mein hon ya jihaad mein hon, kaha ke agar yeh hamare paas hote to na marte aur na maare jaate, is ki wajah yeh thi ke is khayaal ko Allah Taala un ki dili hasrat ka sabab bana de, Allah Taala jilaata hai aur maarta hai aur Allah tumhare amal ko dekh raha hai.
ayahs.157: Qasam hai agar Allah Taala ki raah mein shaheed kiye jaao ya apni maut maro to beshak Allah Taala ki bakhshish-o-rehmat is se behtar hai jise yeh jama kar rahe hain.
ayahs.158: Bilyaqeen khwaah tum mar jaao ya maar daale jaao jama to Allah Taala ki taraf hi kiye jaaoge.
ayahs.159: Allah Taala ki rehmat ke baais aap un par narm dil hain aur agar aap bad-zabaan aur sakht dil hote to yeh sab aap ke paas se chhat jaate, so aap un se darguzar karen aur un ke liye istighfaar karen aur kaam ka mashwara un se kiya karen, phir jab aap ka pukhta iraada ho jaaye to Allah Taala par bharosa karen, beshak Allah Taala tawakkul karne walon se muhabbat karta hai.
ayahs.160: Agar Allah Taala tumhari madad kare to tum par koi ghaalib nahi aa sakta aur agar woh tumhe chhod de to us ke baad kaun hai jo tumhari madad kare? Imaan walon ko Allah Taala hi par bharosa rakhna chaahiye.
ayahs.161: Naamumkin hai ke nabi se khayaanat ho jaaye, har khayaanat karne wala khayaanat ko liye hue qayamat ke din haazir hoga, phir har shakhs ko apne aamaal ka poora poora badla diya jaayega, aur woh zulm na kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.162: Kya pas woh shakhs jo Allah Taala ki khushnoodi ke darpe hai, us shakhs jaisa hai jo Allah Taala ki naaraazgi le kar lautta hai? Aur jis ki jagah jahannam hai jo badtareen jagah hai.
ayahs.163: Allah Taala ke paas un ke alag alag darje hain aur un ke tamaam aamaal ko Allah bakhoobi dekh raha hai.
ayahs.164: Beshak musalmaanon par Allah Taala ka bada ehsaan hai ke un hi mein se ek Rasool un mein bheja, jo unhe us ki aayaten padh kar sunaata hai aur unhe paak karta hai aur unhe kitaab aur hikmat sikhaata hai, yaqeenan yeh sab is se pehle khuli gumraahi mein the.
ayahs.165: (Kya baat hai) ke jab tumhe ek aisi takleef pahunchi ke tum is jaisi do chand pahuncha chuke, to yeh kehne lage ke yeh kahaan se aa gayi? Aap keh dijiye ke yeh khud tumhari taraf se hai, beshak Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.166: Aur tumhe jo kuch us din pahuncha jis din do jamaaton mein mudbhed hui thi, woh sab Allah ke hukm se tha aur is liye ke Allah Taala imaan walon ko zaahiri taur par jaan le.
ayahs.167: Aur munaafiqon ko bhi maloom kar le jin se kaha gaya ke aao Allah ki raah mein jihaad karo, ya kaafiron ko hataao, to woh kehne lage ke agar hum ladaai jaante hote to zaroor saath dete, woh us din ba-nisbat imaan ke kufr se bahut qareeb the, apne munh se woh baaten banaate hain jo un ke dilon mein nahi, aur Allah Taala khoob jaanta hai jise woh chhupaate hain.
ayahs.168: Yeh woh log hain jo khud bhi baithe rahe aur apne bhaiyon ki baabat kaha ke agar woh bhi hamari baat maan lete to qatl na kiye jaate. Keh dijiye! Ke agar tum sachche ho to apni jaanon se maut ko hata do.
ayahs.169: Jo log Allah ki raah mein shaheed kiye gaye hain un ko hargiz murda na samjhen, balke woh zinda hain apne Rabb ke paas roziyaan diye jaate hain.
ayahs.170: Allah Taala ne apna fazl jo unhe de rakha hai us se bahut khush hain aur khushiyaan mana rahe hain un logon ki baabat jo ab tak un se nahi mile un ke peechhe hain, is par ke unhe na koi khauf hai aur na woh ghamgeen honge.
ayahs.171: Woh khush hote hain Allah ki ne'mat aur fazl se aur is se bhi ke Allah Taala imaan walon ke ajr ko barbaad nahi karta.
ayahs.172: Jin logon ne Allah aur Rasool ke hukm ko qubool kiya is ke baad ke unhe poore zakhm lag chuke the, un mein se jinhon ne neki ki aur parhezgaari barti un ke liye bahut ziyaada ajr hai.
ayahs.173: Woh log ke jab un se logon ne kaha ke kaafiron ne tumhare muqaable par lashkar jama kar liye hain, tum un se khauf khaao to is baat ne unhe imaan mein aur badha diya aur kehne lage hamein Allah kaafi hai aur woh bahut achha kaarsaaz hai.
ayahs.174: (Nateeja yeh hua ke) Allah ki ne'mat-o-fazl ke saath yeh laute, unhe koi buraai na pahunchi, unhon ne Allah Taala ki razaamandi ki pairwi ki, Allah bahut bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.175: Yeh khabar dene wala sirf shaitaan hi hai jo apne doston se daraata hai, tum un kaafiron se na daro aur mera khauf rakho, agar tum momin ho.
ayahs.176: Kufr mein aage badhne wale log tujhe ghamnaak na karen, yaqeen maano ke yeh Allah Taala ka kuch na bigaad sakenge, Allah Taala ka iraada hai ke un ke liye aakhirat ka koi hissa ata na kare, aur un ke liye bada azaab hai.
ayahs.177: Kufr ko imaan ke badle khareedne wale hargiz hargiz Allah Taala ko koi nuqsaan nahi pahuncha sakte aur un hi ke liye alamnak azaab hai.
ayahs.178: Kaafir log hamari di hui mohlat ko apne haq mein behtar na samjhen, yeh mohlat to is liye hai ke woh gunaahon mein aur badh jaayen, un hi ke liye zaleel karne wala azaab hai.
ayahs.179: Jis haal mein tum ho isi par Allah imaan walon ko na chhod dega jab tak ke paak aur napaak ko alag alag na kar de, aur na Allah Taala aisa hai ke tumhe ghaib se aagaah kar de, balke Allah Taala apne Rasoolon mein se jis ka chaahe intikhaab kar leta hai, is liye tum Allah Taala par aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan rakho, agar tum imaan laao aur taqwa karo to tumhare liye bada bhaari ajr hai.
ayahs.180: Jinhe Allah Taala ne apne fazl se kuch de rakha hai woh us mein apni kanjoosi ko apne liye behtar khayaal na karen balke woh un ke liye nihaayat badtar hai, anqareeb qayamat wale din yeh apni kanjoosi ki cheez ke tauq daale jaayenge, aasmaanon aur zameen ki miraas Allah Taala hi ke liye aur jo kuch tum kar rahe ho, us se Allah Taala aagaah hai.
ayahs.181: Yaqeenan Allah Taala ne un logon ka qaul bhi suna jinhon ne kaha ke Allah Taala faqeer hai aur hum tawangar hain, un ke is qaul ko hum likh lenge. Aur un ka ambiya ko bila wajah qatl karna bhi, aur hum un se kahenge ke jalne wala azaab chakho!
ayahs.182: Yeh tumhare pesh-karda aamaal ka badla hai aur Allah Taala apne bandon par zulm karne wala nahi.
ayahs.183: Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne kaha ke Allah Taala ne hamein hukm diya hai ke kisi Rasool ko na maanen jab tak woh hamare paas aisi qurbaani na laaye jise aag kha jaaye. Aap keh dijiye ke agar tum sachche ho to mujh se pehle tumhare paas jo Rasool deegar mojzon ke saath yeh bhi laaye jise tum keh rahe ho to phir tum ne unhe kyun maar daala?
ayahs.184: Phir bhi agar yeh log aap ko jhutlaayen to aap se pehle bhi bahut se Rasool jhutlaaye gaye hain jo roshan daleelen, saheefe aur munawwar kitaab le kar aaye.
ayahs.185: Har jaan maut ka maza chakhne wali hai aur qayamat ke din tum apne badle poore poore diye jaaoge, pas jo shakhs aag se hata diya jaaye aur jannat mein daakhil kar diya jaaye beshak woh kaamyaab hogaya, aur dunya ki zindagi to sirf dhoke ki jins hai.
ayahs.186: Yaqeenan tumhare maal-o-jaanon se tumhari aazmaaish ki jaayegi aur yeh bhi yaqeen hai ke tumhe un logon ki jo tum se pehle kitaab diye gaye aur mushrikon ki bahut si dukh dene wali baaten bhi sunni padengi aur agar tum sabr kar lo aur parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karo to yaqeenan yeh bahut badi himmat ka kaam hai.
ayahs.187: Aur Allah Taala ne jab ahl-e-kitaab se ahd liya ke tum ise sab logon se zaroor bayaan karoge aur ise chhupaaoge nahi, to phir bhi un logon ne is ahd ko apni peeth peechhe daal diya aur ise bahut kam qeemat par bech daala. Un ka yeh beopaar bahut bura hai.
ayahs.188: Woh log jo apne kartooton par khush hain aur chaahte hain ke jo unhon ne nahi kiya us par bhi un ki tareefen ki jaayen, aap unhe azaab se chhutkaara mein na samajhiye, un ke liye to dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.189: Aasmaanon aur zameen ki baadshaahi Allah hi ke liye hai aur Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.190: Aasmaanon aur zameen ki paidaaish mein aur raat din ke her pher mein yaqeenan aqalmandon ke liye nishaaniyaan hain.
ayahs.191: Jo Allah Taala ka zikr khade aur baithe aur apni karwaton par lete hue karte hain aur aasmanon-o-zameen ki paidaaish mein ghaur-o-fikr karte hain aur kehte hain aye hamare parwardigaar! Tu ne yeh be-faaida nahi banaya, tu paak hai pas hamein aag ke azaab se bacha le.
ayahs.192: Aye hamare paalne wale! Tu jise jahannam mein daale yaqeenan tu ne use ruswa kiya, aur zaalimon ka madadgaar koi nahi.
ayahs.193: Aye hamare Rabb! Hum ne suna ke munaadi karne wala ba-awaz-e-buland imaan ki taraf bula raha hai ke logo! Apne Rabb par imaan laao, pas hum imaan laaye. Ya ilahi ab tu hamare gunaah maaf farma aur hamari buraaiyaan hum se door kar de aur hamari maut nekon ke saath kar.
ayahs.194: Aye hamare paalne wale mabood! Hamein woh de jis ka waada tu ne hum se apne Rasoolon ki zabaani kiya hai aur hamein qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, yaqeenan tu waada khilaafi nahi karta.
ayahs.195: Pas un ke Rabb ne un ki dua qubool farma li ke tum mein se kisi kaam karne wale ke kaam ko khwaah woh mard ho ya aurat main hargiz zaaya nahi karta, tum aapas mein ek doosre ke humjins ho, is liye woh log jinhon ne hijrat ki aur apne gharon se nikaal diye gaye aur jinhe meri raah mein eeza di gayi aur jinhon ne jihaad kiya aur shaheed kiye gaye, main zaroor zaroor un ki buraaiyaan un se door kar doonga aur bilyaqeen unhe un jannaton mein le jaaoonga jin ke neeche nahren beh rahi hain, yeh hai sawaab Allah Taala ki taraf se aur Allah Taala hi ke paas behtareen sawaab hai.
ayahs.196: Tujhe kaafiron ka shehron mein chalna phirna fareb mein na daal de.
ayahs.197: Yeh to bahut hi thoda faaida hai, is ke baad un ka thikaana to jahannam hai aur woh buri jagah hai.
ayahs.198: Lekin jo log apne Rabb se darte rahe un ke liye jannaten hain jin ke neeche nahren jaari hain, un mein woh hamesha rahenge, yeh mehmaani hai Allah ki taraf se aur nek kaaron ke liye jo kuch Allah Taala ke paas hai woh bahut hi behtar hai.
ayahs.199: Yaqeenan ahl-e-kitaab mein se baaz aise bhi hain jo Allah Taala par imaan laate hain aur tumhari taraf jo utaara gaya hai aur un ki jaanib jo naazil hua us par bhi, Allah Taala se darte hain aur Allah Taala ki aayaton ko thodi thodi qeemat par bechte bhi nahi, un ka badla un ke Rabb ke paas hai, yaqeenan Allah Taala jald hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.200: Aye imaan walo! Tum sabit-qadam raho aur ek doosre ko thaame rakho aur jihaad ke liye taiyaar raho aur Allah Taala se darte raho taake tum muraad ko pahuncho.
